# authwise_guard_node (Data Source)

A server's node in a Guard network, registered ahead of time. Created without a `public_key`, it is `PENDING` and its one-time `auth_code` enrols the server; created with one, it is `ACTIVE` at once. The auth code is shown once, so it is kept in state: treat the state as sensitive. People's nodes join by invite and are not managed here. This data source reads one by its full resource name.



<!-- schema generated by tfplugindocs -->
## Schema

### Required

- `name` (String) Full resource name of the object to read.

### Read-Only

- `address` (String)
- `allowed_ips` (List of String)
- `auth_code` (String, Sensitive)
- `auth_code_expires_at` (String)
- `config` (String)
- `display_name` (String)
- `endpoint` (String)
- `guard_node_id` (String) Server-assigned resource id — the last segment of `name`, and what other resources' `*_id` attributes take.
- `labels` (Map of String)
- `last_seen_at` (String)
- `network_id` (String)
- `owner_id` (String)
- `public_key` (String)
- `roles` (List of String)
- `state` (String)
- `tenant_id` (String)
